escena: SCENE: a real enterprise product-launch rehearsal in a monumental but believable digital experience space. The PHYSICAL corner LED wall fills the middle of the photograph, turning from the left wall into the deep right corridor. Its authored campaign world is unmistakable: one cobalt-blue sculptural wave cuts across a warm ivory product landscape, then continues into a different composition on a narrow physical display at the end of the corridor. An orange-red slit of real LED light marks a precise threshold in that campaign world; it is the ONLY warm accent. A business lead, small in the lower-right third and photographed from behind in natural movement, crosses that threshold toward the new installation while checking the placement of the second display with a raised hand. She wears light warm-neutral clothing, no dark corporate suit, no gaze to camera, no pose. The screen world is a digital campaign for a fictional new consumer product: one unbranded sculptural device photographed in the visuals, coherent yet not repeated as copy-paste. The person makes a real launch decision, and the art is the hero. Actual pixel texture, display seams, cast light on polished concrete, subtle atmospheric depth and scale, 35mm lens, low camera point. No printed collateral, no paper, no fake portal, no HUD, no readable text, no logos. THE EXACT MOMENT: the lead reaches out to compare where the blue campaign wave continues across the corner just before the rehearsal goes live.

lecho.objeto: the pale polished concrete floor directly below the lens at the entrance to the digital installation
lecho.tono: VERY LIGHT warm concrete, almost white, with real fine grain

texto.muro: a continuous area of charcoal acoustic fabric wall above the entire scene, in deep warm shadow with subtle visible woven texture
